repository.description: The repository location to backup to or restore from. e.g., '/media/backup' or 'sftp:server:/path'

password_file.description: Path to a file containing the repository password.

cache_dir.description: Directory to use for the local cache.

limit_upload.description: Limit upload speed in KiB/s. 0 means unlimited.

limit_download.description: Limit download speed in KiB/s. 0 means unlimited.

pack_size.description: Target pack size in MiB. 0 means use default.

retry_lock.description: Duration to retry locking the repository, e.g., '5m' or '2h'.

options.description: List of extended options in 'key=value' format passed to --option.

cacert.description: Path to a file containing root certificates to use.

tls_client_cert.description: Path to a file containing PEM encoded TLS client certificate and private key.

key_hint.description: Key ID of the key to try decrypting first.

http_user_agent.description: User agent string for outgoing HTTP requests.

no_cache.description: Do not use a local cache.

no_extra_verify.description: Skip additional verification of data before upload.

stuck_request_timeout.description: Duration after which to retry stuck requests, e.g., '5m'.
